detail.longDescription:
The JUNG Smart Visu Server app gives you direct access to your JUNG Smart Visu Server – and with it, your KNX visualisation. The Smart Visu Server makes your home smart: enjoy atmosphere, comfort and security at the tap of a finger.

Lighting, blinds and shutters, heating and climate, music or IP cameras – you control and configure it all from your smartphone or tablet. The user-friendly Smart Visu Home interface makes every function and action easy to operate, and adapts automatically to your screen size.

Several servers, one app

New: manage several SV-Servers conveniently in one app and switch between them with a single tap – whether it's your home, your holiday home or the office. Set up each server's connection exactly as you need it: locally on your network only, via secure remote access through myJUNG only, or both. If both are set up, the app recognises where you are and switches automatically between the local connection and remote access. There's nothing for you to change.

Your home, your rules

Scenes and actions let you decide what happens together: dim the lights, close the blinds and start your favourite playlist – all with one tap. With the astro function, lighting and shading follow sunrise and sunset automatically, and the presence simulation gives you peace of mind when you're away for longer. You can adjust everything yourself, whenever you like, without waiting for an appointment.

Everything connected

The Smart Visu Server links your KNX installation with the smart systems you already use: Philips Hue, Sonos, sonoro, JUNG HOME and SmartThings. You control them directly in the app – no switching between different apps.

Your benefits at a glance

- Direct access to your KNX visualization
- Central control of lighting, blinds, heating, climate, music and cameras
- Several SV-Servers in one app – local, remote via myJUNG, or both
- Automatic switching between local connection and remote access
- Custom scenes and actions, timer and astro function
- Integration of Philips Hue, Sonos, sonoro, JUNG HOME and SmartThings
- Encrypted communication, roles and permissions for up to 24 users

Requirements

To use the app, you need a JUNG Smart Visu Server on your network. Access from outside your home network requires a myJUNG account and the SV-Remote remote access licence.
